texts.text: ONE TRAP. ONE WAY OUT.
THE INSIDER ALWAYS WINS THE CONTRACT — UNTIL THE NETWORK LETS PEOPLE BUY DIRECTLY, NO PERMISSION NEEDED.
MODERN GOVERNMENT
IT FOR EVERYONE
Invest in the future!
you have no required certificate. you do not fit the rules.
tools are just a means. the money is what matters — that battle I have already won.
build it for one tenth of the price. take it or leave it.
what?! my own work — at a tenth of the price?!
The public agrees a new public IT system is needed, paid from the budget, paid from taxes.
Behind closed doors, the procurement clerk and the insider design the tender to fit one company. An envelope changes hands.
The clerk shrugs. His pocket bulges with bribes.
The contract is awarded. The insider has the licence — but no skill, and no respect for the work.
The insider visits the neighbor. The 'kind offer' is the smallest crumb.
1. TRADITIONAL
the complaint
silence
the closed door
at the lawyer
we will look into it, please leave it with us.
DEADLINES PASSED
office hours over
principles are admirable. justice you will not get — and it will cost you a fortune.
the office WILL BE certainly fined — paid from the public budget
the fine funds the next rigged tender
corruption keeps its job, and gets a raise
Complaint, silence, deadlines, lawyer.
The trap is built into the rules themselves.
Where regulation is a moat network is a bridge.
REPUTATION NETWORK
— this is where the new world begins —
2. REPUTATION NETWORK
delivery first
publishing my app
demand finds it
TOMÁŠ'S APP
tap here to support the maker
they're using it!
a decent living
DIRECT SERVICE — NO PERMISSION NEEDED
MAKER TIPS
He delivers first. People find the app and use it.
Each grateful user pays a little. A decent living. No central authority to bribe.
Reputation is the new Delivery is the proof.
Two paths. The trap is in the rules. The way out is to bypass the rules altogether.

* When the rules are written by the insider, complaining inside the rules is the trap — even the fines feed back into the next rigged tender. The reputation network is the way out: citizens find the product, pay the maker directly, and the community confers the only licence that matters — trust earned by delivery.
